title: Answer: mammals, possibly all vertebrates, possibly insects

statements.text: Any process that generates a world model coherent in space, time and cause for itself and its environment is conscious: all mammals, possibly all vertebrates and possibly insects. Rocks, viruses, single cells, plants and insect colonies are not, C. elegans probably not, and brainstems alone probably not. IWMT has no clear position on whether unlimited associative learning marks consciousness.

sources.quote: e.g., all mammals, possibly all vertebrates, and possibly insects
